Name: Elegant_Shane_Portrait and Character
Author: tuoba514
Description:
Bilingual annotations（English and Chinese）：
My English is not very good！So we can only use translation！！（我的英语不是很好！所以只能用翻译）
I can't read the instructions on the web， so if you find any errors， please let me know！（我看不懂网站的说明，如果发现错误可以告诉我）
I just made modifications to Shane while keep the original settings（我只是在保留原版设定的基础上对谢恩进行修改）
This mod beautification includes winter clothing and ginger island.And characters（此模组美化包括冬装和姜岛，以及行走图）
Need to install SMAPI and two front-end modules, portrait and content patches（需要安装SMAPI和两个前端模块：肖像和内容补丁程序）
After decompression，All files in this folder have bilingual operation explanations as their names（此文件夹中文件都有双语操作解释作为名字）
================================================================================================================================
Operation Tutorial（操作教程）：
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Front module（前置模组）：
First, you need to download the pre mod portrait and content patch program.Place it in the mod folder（首先需要下载前置mod肖像和内容补丁程序,将其放入文件夹）
Note:Portrait module with tail number 999 needs to be installed（需要安装尾号999的Portraiture模组）
==============================================================================================================================
Character installation（行走图）Two methods（两种方法）：
(第一种方法)1.Drag the mod directly into the（将mod直接拖入mods文件夹）
On the premise of downloading the pre mod（在下载完前置mod的前提下）
Then download this beautification mod,After decompression（然后下载这个美化mod，解压后）
Drag [CP] Shane.Character to the Stardew Valley mod folder（将[CP] Shane_Character拖动至星露谷mod文件夹）
To complete the character installation（即可完成行走图安装）
（第二种办法）2.Replace the original shane file in Characters（替换 Characters中谢恩的源文件）
hen download this beautification mod,After decompression（然后下载这个美化mod，解压后）
take“Methods for replacing source files”Drag to Characters（将文件夹中的文件拖动至星露谷文件的Characters中/文件夹有双语解释操作）
To complete the character installation（即可完成行走图安装）
=======================================================================================================================
Portrait installation（肖像）：
The PNG format of the portrait needs to be opened separately in the Portraits folder and dragged into it.（其中肖像的png格式需要另外再点开Portraits文件夹，将肖像拖动进去。）
Because it includes three types of daily, winter, and island images（因为它包括三种类型的日常、冬季和姜岛图像）
I have set up a separate folder and can drag it directly to the Portraits folder（我已经设置好了独立文件夹，直接拖动至Portraits文件夹即可）
For a better experience, according to the scene season, press p to change in the game（为了更好的体验，根据场景季节，在游戏中按p
Or watch the high-definition portrait mod import video for step-by-step operation（﻿或者观看“高清肖像mod的导入”视频逐步操作/国人推荐bilibili）

Downloads.Description: Please make sure to download the pre file（请一定要下载前置文件）

Fixed bug where walking charts and portraits cannot be displayed
And the method of replacing the symbol source file
修复了行走图和肖像无法显示的bug，以及更新了替换行走图源文件的办法
